description: Answers "where should the next dollar go" (view backer) or "what should I do next near me" (view worker): one ranked list of open claimable jobs, place conditions that are not yet covered, and open outcome bids, each row explained in plain words by named score parts that add up to its score. It composes reads that already exist: open claimable work and its funding state, the Standing of the places it sits at (which conditions are not yet covered or are due to be measured again), votes, market admission and open outcome bids, and creates no store. The scoring table is in every reply. OUR OWN ACTIVITY NEVER RAISES A SCORE: only votes the board's own rule counted score, demand the records call ours scores nothing, and a bid placed by the house earns nothing. A count nobody could read is a dash, never a zero, and the row says what was not read. Pay is proposed unless a job is funded, and a person accepts every proof. In the worker view, give lat and lng to see only work within radiusKm of you (default 25); remote work stays. Free, keyless, read-only. VEALTH IS AN EXPERIMENT AND THIS IS A READING OF THE BOARD, NOT ADVICE: a rank is no promise that a job will be funded, accepted or paid, and says nothing about anyone's fitness for a job. The reply ends with the top row's own next call.

lat.description: Your latitude, from -90 to 90. Send with lng. Optional; with it nearness scores and the worker view drops work beyond radiusKm.

limit.description: Most rows to return, from 1 to 50. Defaults to 10.

lng.description: Your longitude, from -180 to 180. Send with lat.

radiusKm.description: Kilometres around you, from 0.1 to 500. Defaults to 25. Needs lat and lng.

view.description: backer (the default): who and where to back next. worker: what to do next near me.

name: support_next
title: Where the next dollar or the next hour does the most
